title: Flame retardant modification of partially oriented poly(ethylene terephthalate) fibers – structural conditions of application
authors: Andrzej Gawłowski; Janusz Fabia; Czesław Ślusarczyk; Tadeusz Graczyk; Anna Pielesz
source_version: Original published seven-page journal PDF from Biblioteka Nauki repository
composition: Commercial PET POY fibers from Torlen Sp. z o.o., Toruń, Poland, finished with commercial sodium water-glass from Rudniki SA, CAS 1344-09-8. Exact yarn count, fiber diameter and retained coating mass unreported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Corresponding finished and prescribed-washed PET POY fiber sample. TG mass, pan, gas flow, cutting or grinding, conditioning and replicate count not stated. Source TG method gives 30–800 °C at 10 deg/min; Figure 3 caption and flammability results independently identify air.
LOI_method: PN–ISO 4589; own measured minimum oxygen percentage in oxygen/nitrogen mixture supporting ignition and sustained burning
LOI_specimen_preparation: Corresponding finished PET POY fibers; results are means of several tests, exact n unspecified. Instrument model, LOI specimen geometry, conditioning and uncertainty not reported.
LOI_statistic: mean of several tests, exact replicate count unspecified
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact numerical peak labels printed on original Figure 3 DTG inset, verified visually by label/curve colors and caption; no graph digitization. Matching LOI is tabulated in Table 1.
TG_locator: Figure 3, p 851: printed labels 567.9, 585.0, 567.7 and 569.2 at later combustion/oxidation DTG maxima, with colored composition labels and caption; flammability discussion pp 850–851
LOI_locator: Table 1, p 850, corresponding PET POY + WG concentration at 115 °C
conditions_locator: Experimental p 849: source material, finishing wash and separate LOI/DSC/TGA methods; air attribution pp 850–851 and Figure 3 caption
source_location: Whole original seven-page journal PDF pp 848–854, all methods, Tables 1–3, Figures 1–5, conclusions and references reviewed. Original p 849–851 method, LOI and numerical TG-label pixels inspected.
washing_state: After the prescribed post-modification wash in 5 g/dm³ Pretepon G at 60 °C for 30 min; no separate durability-wash series assigned
treatment_chemistry: Commercial sodium water-glass in aqueous finishing bath; NNO dispersant; Pretepon G detergent finishing wash
source_peak_definition: Later DTG maximum from combustion of the organic carbonization residue, after primary PET thermal dissociation; recorded as Tmax2_C. First PET decomposition maximum is not numerically extracted.
limitations: Four independently reviewed treated PET POY fiber states. Exact source-printed Figure 3 labels are used, with no coordinate estimation. Temperatures describe later combustion of organic residue and are stored as second DTG peaks; main polymer decomposition peaks are blank. The conventional PET stand. comparator in Figures 2/3 is distinguished from PET POY stand. in Table 1: its 458.8/450.7/545.5 °C TG labels and 83.7/15.4% losses repeat the earlier conventional-PET source DOI 10.1007/s10973-016-5498-3. That comparator is not paired with POY control LOI 21.7. Earlier source methods10 versus Figure2 20 deg/min conflict is not transferred to these newly treated POY experiments; current own method is 10 deg/min and own Figure3 identifies air. No gas flow or nitrogen method is borrowed from DSC or the earlier paper. Source methods omit 3.0% WG from the preparation list, although Table1 and structural results contain it; this unpaired variant stays held. The 10.0% variant has measured LOI but no corresponding Figure3 TG, and water-only blank-bath specimens receive DSC/WAXS only. Bath concentration is source wt%; retained add-on and individual fiber uptake are unknown. Mandatory detergent wash belongs to finishing before tests; no extra wash-cycle interpretation. Post-wash drying, TG mass/pan/flow/replicates and LOI instrument/geometry/conditioning/exact n/SD are unreported. Mean of several tests is preserved without inventing n. DSC melting/cold-crystallization temperatures and X-ray crystallinity are separate assays. Source acknowledges presenting material at the December2016 X-Ray Investigations of Polymer Structure conference; any later proceedings source needs a specific reuse check. Related 2014 Roflam E source reports DSC/WAXS for different treatments, not these WG POY states.
sample_state: PET POY fiber treated in source 0.3 wt% WG bath at 115 °C, after prescribed finishing wash
treatment_method: Treat PET POY fibers in Ahiba Turbomat at liquor ratio 1:50, 115 °C for 1 h, preparative ramp 2.5 °C/min, with source 0.3 wt% sodium water-glass solution and 1.5 g/dm³ Dyspergator NNO. After modification wash in 5 g/dm³ Pretepon G detergent at 60 °C for 30 min. Post-wash drying conditions are not stated. The unsuccessful 130 °C preparative trial is not this state.
pairing_evidence: Table 1 gives measured LOI 28.0% for PET POY+0.3%WG at 115 °C. Figure 3 caption and colored labels explicitly identify that same preparation and print later DTG maximum 567.9 °C. The paper separates these modified POY fibers from conventional PET control and from unmodified POY fibers.
